name: succinylcholine
notes: Ultra-short-acting depolarizing NMB; hydrolyzed in plasma by butyrylcholinesterase (BCHE, 'plasma/pseudo-cholinesterase'). Atypical (dibucaine-resistant) BCHE markedly PROLONGS the block (the canonical anesthetic pharmacogenetic kinetic fact, v0.9). Also an MH trigger. Effect measured by train-of-four (TOF).
